ways.label: Douglas Range Route, west to east from the Aorere Valley to the Cobb

start.name: Road end, track start behind the intentions shelter
start.quote: The track starts just across the paddock behind the intentions shelter.

evidence: The route is described west to east (from the Aorere Valley end).
This guide covers the route linking the Aorere Valley to the Cobb reservoir via Boulder Lake, Adelaide Tarn, Lonely Lake and the Cobb Valley.
### Fenella Hut to Trilobite Hut/roadend (4-5 hr)
